body:
Profiled the release UI with ordinary HTTPS pairing on a synthetic fixture of three projects and 37 cards. Navigation waits about 204 ms before sending its first request because all changed view queries share a 200 ms debounce. Local median List navigation is 242 ms; opening a card is 29 ms.

With simulated 100 ms request latency, 6 Mbps download and 4x CPU slowdown, median first List load is 879 ms, warm reload 515 ms and List navigation 350 ms. Recommended priorities are immediate navigation reads, deferred editor/Markdown/settings code and fewer serial loading stages. Existing gzip, caching and lazy planning chunks are already present.

This was assessment only: no application code, API contracts or runtime settings changed. These measurements do not establish physical-device, real-network or large-project acceptance. Method, limits and candidates: progress/2026-09-29-loading-profile.md.

metadata.summary: Loading profile identifies avoidable navigation latency
